title: Credit for an Estimate-Stage Pre-Repair Scan Against Unrelated-Damage Work (Insurance Claim Repairs)
content:
A pre-repair scan fee charged on a customer-pay estimate of the same vehicle under Repair Estimates & Appointments, where that estimate still stands as a written estimate — neither converted nor declined nor expired — is credited against an unrelated-damage addition to the vehicle's Insurance Claim Repairs repair order, up to what the customer paid on that estimate.

## Amount that can be credited

The paid fee is the pre-repair scan fee charged on that estimate, but no more than the total the customer has paid on that estimate: the lesser of the two.

## How much of the paid fee is credited

The days are calendar days counted from the estimate written date as day zero, up to the day the addition's consent is signed. The two day limits are those of the estimate's own type under Repair Estimates & Appointments: its conversion credit window days and its validity days.

| Consent signed, counted from the estimate written date | Credit |
|---|---|
| no more than the estimate type's conversion credit window days | the paid fee in full |
| later than that, but no more than the estimate type's validity days | 50 percent of the paid fee, rounded to the cent |
| any other case — later than the validity days, or no customer-pay estimate of the vehicle standing as a written estimate | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, written in terms of the estimate type's own limits)

- Consent signed on the last day of the conversion credit window: full credit.
- Signed on the next day: 50 percent.
- Signed on the last day of the validity period: 50 percent.
- Signed on the next day: nothing.
- The estimate was converted, declined or has expired: nothing, whatever the days.

## Hypothetical amounts

A pre-repair scan fee of USD 120.00 was charged on the written estimate and the customer has paid USD 80.00 on it. The paid fee is USD 80.00. Inside the conversion credit window the credit is USD 80.00; after it but within validity, 50 percent, USD 40.00. Had the customer paid USD 150.00 on that estimate, the paid fee would be the full USD 120.00, and the late credit USD 60.00.
